ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Loaded From Suspicious Location Via Cmspt.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects cmstp loading "dll" or "ocx" files from suspicious locations Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\.ocx$")))
